name: RollingSampleBuffer
desc: Fixed-capacity ring buffer that keeps the last capacity samples.

name: snapshot
desc: The buffered samples, oldest first.

name: SavedSignalSample
desc: Paths of a saved signal sample.

name: save
desc:
Writes signal_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss.wav (16-bit PCM) and a .json sidecar
with timestamp, note, audio parameters and, when given, the decoded
message (text, SNR, modulation mode, bytes) to samples/.

name: SignalStatusBar
desc: Interactive and animated signal status bar mounted at the top of the dashboard.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: agcCreate
desc: Creates a native AGC instance (targetRms 0 = default 0.25).

name: agcProcess
desc: Applies AGC in place to len floats at samples (caller-owned buffer).

name: hasAgc
desc: Whether the loaded library exports the AGC API.

name: hasEqualizedSymbols
desc: Whether the loaded library exports ofdmEqualizedSymbols.

name: maxFrameSamples
desc:
Upper bound on samples we are willing to allocate for one frame
(~95 s at 44.1 kHz). Guards against absurd sizes from bad configs; the
TX path sizes frames to stay below it (FrameGeometry.txFrameSampleBudget).

name: ofdmEqualizedSymbols
desc:
Demodulates a frame-aligned OFDM frame and returns its equalized
data-subcarrier points as interleaved I/Q pairs (at most maxPoints
points, in symbol order). Throws SwException on native errors.

name: SoundwaveStorage.new
desc:
baseDirectory defaults to the application documents directory; tests
pass a temporary directory.

name: clear
desc:
Deletes every file in area except paths in keep (e.g. a recording
that is still being written). Returns the number of files deleted.

name: directory
desc: The directory for area, created if missing.

name: root
desc: <base>/soundwave

name: usageBytes
desc: Bytes used by area, or by all areas when area is null.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: formatBytes
desc: Human-readable size, e.g. 1.4 MB.

name: SignalColors
desc:
Status colors for link state, SNR and frame badges. Each one is readable
as text (>= 4.5:1) on all surface containers of its brightness.

name: badgeAlpha
desc: Alpha for tinted badge backgrounds; keeps badge text above 4.5:1.

name: copyWith
desc:
Creates a copy of this theme extension with the given fields
replaced by the non-null parameter values.

name: lerp
desc: Linearly interpolate with another ThemeExtension object.

name: of
desc:
The theme's signal colors, falling back to the built-in set matching
the theme brightness (e.g. in tests that use a bare MaterialApp).

name: PeakHold
desc:
Per-bin peak hold: a peak is held for holdSeconds, then falls at
decayDbPerSecond until the live spectrum catches up with it.

name: peaks
desc: Current peak spectrum, or null before the first update.

name: update
desc: Folds in a new spectrum observed dtSeconds after the previous one.

name: SpectrumAnalyzer
desc: Turns a stream of audio samples into dBFS magnitude spectra.

name: addSamples
desc:
Appends samples; returns the spectra of frames completed by them,
oldest first (at most maxFramesPerPush, see there).

name: analyze
desc: dBFS spectrum of exactly fftSize samples (oldest first).

name: binCount
desc: Bins from DC to Nyquist inclusive.

name: binForFrequency
desc: Nearest bin to hz, clamped to 0, binCount - 1.

name: binWidthHz
desc: Frequency spacing between bins in Hz.

name: fftSize
desc: FFT length in samples (power of two).

name: frequencyOfBin
desc: Centre frequency of bin k in Hz.

name: hopSize
desc: Samples between the starts of consecutive frames.

name: maxFramesPerPush
desc:
Most frames produced for one addSamples call. When a large chunk
would produce more (slow device, backlog), only the newest frames are
computed so the display stays current instead of falling behind.

name: reset
desc: Discards buffered samples (e.g. after a sample-rate change or pause).

name: sampleRate
desc: Audio sample rate in Hz.

name: secondsPerFrame
desc: Seconds of audio between consecutive frames.

name: SpectrumAnalyzerWidget
desc: Spectrum analyzer plot driven by a SpectrumController.

name: bandLowHz
desc: Highlighted band (default: the 18-22 kHz ultrasonic band).

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: minFrequencyHz
desc: Displayed frequency range; maxFrequencyHz null means Nyquist.

name: SpectrumController
desc: Latest spectrum plus peak hold; repaints are throttled to frameInterval.

name: binWidthHz
desc: Frequency spacing between bins in Hz.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: minDb
desc: Plot range in dBFS.

name: peakBin
desc: Index of the strongest bin within lowHz, highHz, or null.

name: peaks
desc: Peak-hold spectrum, or null before the first frame.

name: spectrum
desc: Most recent spectrum (dBFS per bin), or null before the first frame.

name: update
desc: Adds a spectrum computed dtSeconds after the previous one.

name: SpectrumPainter
desc: Paints the spectrum, peak hold, band highlight and axes.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: ThroughputCalculator
desc: Rolling time-window throughput calculator.

name: calculateBitsPerSecond
desc: Calculates the rolling bits-per-second rate over windowDuration.

name: recordTransfer
desc: Records a byte transfer of bytes at timestamp (or now).

name: reset
desc: Resets the throughput history.

name: sampleCount
desc: Current sample count in window.

name: TransferSample
desc: Single byte transfer sample timestamp.

name: FrameTooLongError
desc:
The current modem settings cannot carry even the smallest frame within
the sample limit of the native layer (e.g. CSS SF10 at a very narrow
bandwidth). Shown to the user instead of a native overflow error.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: cancelTransfer
desc: Aborts the fragmented transfer in progress.

name: frameLimitError
desc: Why nothing can be sent with the current config, or null if it can.

name: linkChunkBytes
desc:
Link-layer chunk per fragment so every fragment's frame respects
maxFramePayload. Throws FrameTooLongError if no frame fits.

name: maxFramePayload
desc:
Largest PHY payload per frame for the current config: frames stay
within FrameGeometry.txFrameSampleBudget (about 15 s of airtime, and
always within the native sample limit). 219 bytes for OFDM; less for
slow CSS settings (e.g. 74 bytes at SF10 / 2 kHz).

name: nodeId
desc: Link-layer address of this device (shared with its RxEngine).

name: onControlFrame
desc: Feeds an ACK/NACK received by the RX engine to the ARQ sender.

name: randomNodeId
desc: A random non-zero 16-bit link address.

name: sendBinary
desc:
Sends binary data (up to LinkMessage.maxContentBytes) as a file,
fragmented and, if enabled in settings, protected by ARQ.

name: sendControl
desc: Transmits an ACK/NACK reply produced by the RX engine.

name: sendMessage
desc:
Sends text. Text that fits one frame (see maxFramePayload) without
ARQ uses the legacy raw frame; everything else goes through the link
layer, fragmented to frames of at most maxFramePayload bytes.

name: transfers
desc: Progress of fragmented / ARQ transfers.

name: transmitPayload
desc:
Frames, modulates and plays one PHY payload; returns its airtime.
Playback is asynchronous: this returns once the audio is queued.

name: data
desc: Binary payload for a file transfer (#89); null for text messages.

name: done
desc: Completes when this message has been sent, or with its error.

name: enqueueFile
desc:
Queues a binary file transfer. The returned future completes when the
transfer finishes and fails with its error (e.g. TxMaxRetriesError).

name: UiPreferences.new
desc:
Without a store nothing is persisted and the preferences count as
loaded immediately (used by tests and previews).

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: isLoaded
desc: False until restore has finished (or failed) reading the store.

name: restore
desc:
Loads persisted values. Unknown or mistyped values are ignored, and a
failing store leaves the defaults in place (onboarding is then shown).

name: storePrefix
desc: SharedPreferences key namespace for these values.

name: WaterfallBuffer
desc:
Holds the newest capacity spectra of binCount bins each in one flat
Float32List. Pushing is O(binCount) and never allocates.

name: length
desc: Rows currently stored (<= capacity).

name: push
desc:
Appends row (exactly binCount values), evicting the oldest row
when full.

name: rowAt
desc: View of the row of age (0 = newest). Valid until the next push.

name: slotOfAge
desc: Storage slot of the row of age (0 = newest).

name: totalPushed
desc: Rows pushed since creation or clear, including overwritten ones.

name: valueAt
desc: Value of bin in the row of age (0 = newest).

name: writeSlot
desc:
Storage slot of the next row to be written; the slot of the row of
age a is (writeSlot - 1 - a) mod capacity.

name: WaterfallController
desc: Owns the waterfall history, colour mapping and the rendered image.

name: addRow
desc: Appends one spectrum row (dBFS per bin). Ignored while paused.

name: binWidthHz
desc: Frequency spacing between bins in Hz.

name: buildPixels
desc:
RGBA pixels in display order: image row 0 is the oldest slot, the last
row the newest; rows not yet filled are transparent.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: image
desc: Latest rendered image (rows x bins, oldest row on top), if any.

name: rangeFloorDb
desc: Limits of the dB range control.

name: secondsPerRow
desc: Seconds of audio between consecutive rows.

name: valueAt
desc: Level in dBFS at hz in the row of age (0 = newest), or null.

name: WaterfallPainter
desc: Paints the waterfall image, frequency/time axes and the readout.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: plotRect
desc: Plot area within a canvas of size.

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: WaterfallPlot
desc: The waterfall plot with axes and a hover/touch readout.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: WaterfallRange
desc: Frequency ranges offered by WaterfallView.

name: bounds
desc: (low, high) in Hz for this range, clamped to 0, nyquistHz.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: WaterfallView
desc:
Waterfall plot plus its controls: pause, colour map, frequency range and
dB range (gain/contrast).

name: carrierHz
desc: Centre of the "Carrier +/-500 Hz" zoom.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: WavAudio
desc: Decoded contents of a WAV file.

name: channels
desc: Channel count of the source file (before the mono mix-down).

name: formatTag
desc: WavFormatTag.pcm or WavFormatTag.ieeeFloat (extensible resolved).

name: samples
desc: Mono samples in -1, 1 (multi-channel files are averaged).

name: sizeRepaired
desc:
True when the header sizes were missing or wrong (e.g. a recording
that was interrupted before its header was finalised).

name: WavFormatTag
desc: WAVE format tags.

name: WavSampleFormat
desc: Sample encodings supported when writing a WAV file.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: buildWavHeader
desc:
Builds the canonical 44-byte header for a mono or multi-channel file with
dataLength bytes of sample data.

name: encodeFloat32
desc: Encodes samples as little-endian 32-bit IEEE float.

name: encodePcm16
desc: Encodes samples as little-endian 16-bit PCM.

name: encodeWav
desc: Encodes a complete mono WAV file.

name: parseWav
desc:
Parses a WAV file. Throws FormatException for anything that is not a
readable RIFF/WAVE file.

name: pcm16FromDouble
desc: Quantises one sample in -1, 1 to a signed 16-bit value.

name: wavHeaderLength
desc: Size of the canonical header written by buildWavHeader.

name: wavMaxDataLength
desc: Largest data chunk a RIFF file can describe (its size fields are uint32).

name: addSamples
desc:
Appends samples (in -1, 1) to the recording. Ignored when not
recording. Returns a future that completes once they are on disk.

name: fileNameFor
desc: soundwave_recording_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss.wav

name: path
desc: Path of the file being written (null when not recording).

name: sampleRate
desc: Sample rate written to the header; must match the audio being added.

name: samplesWritten
desc: Samples appended so far.

name: startRecording
desc:
Creates soundwave_recording_<timestamp>.wav in directory (created if
needed) and returns its path. A numeric suffix avoids overwriting a
recording started within the same second.

name: stopRecording
desc:
Finalises the header and closes the file. Throws StateError when not
recording, or the first write error after closing the file.

name: truncated
desc: True if samples were dropped because the RIFF 4 GiB limit was reached.

name: timestampForFileName
desc: YYYYMMDD_HHmmss in local time, used for all generated file names.

name: WaveformController
desc: Most recent windowSize samples and the RMS level of the last chunk.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: levelDbfs
desc: RMS level of the most recent chunk in dBFS.

name: samples
desc: Oldest-first view of the latest samples.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.
